body.x: Heaven Tree will be exhibiting atMES INNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT in CES 2019 EUREKA PARK, the world'slargest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA from January 8 (Tue) to January11 (Fri) BOOTH # 52843) to showcase CLOVINE.

Heaven Tree is a company thatdevelops and sells enterprise programs based on big data, block chains, andcloud technology. Since its establishment in 2017, it has commercializedsystems for manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, institutions, and laboratoriesbased on Betel (Multi-Client Distributed Processing System) technology.

Betel-based CLOVINE is anenterprise process build solution based on cloud server technology, block chaintechnology, and ideal project management philosophy to fundamentally solve theexisting problems of the existing project management system. It provides easyinterface and flexible program configuration, so it can be applied to variousindustries such as consulting, manufacturing, and marketing by configuring theprogram according to user's work process.

In addition, CLOVINE is anenterprise-class program optimized for sharing and collaboration through cloudautomatic synchronization technology, boasting a fast deployment period of 15 to30 days, making it easy and convenient for anyone to use. It is a breakthroughtechnology solution that combines the advantages of the cloud with the securitytechnology of the block chain to ensure speed and security. In addition,CLOVINE can reduce the cost by eliminating the need for expensive physicalserver construction required for existing ERP and PDM.

Heaven Tree's main exportingcountries are Singapore, Hong Kong, Vietnam, Thailand and other Southeast Asiancountries, and they are establishing partnership with companies such as Gartnerto develop trend analysis and development plans for technology development.Thanks to the full support of Gartner, we want Heaven Tree solutions for ENDUSERs worldwide, from sales to marketing. Heaven Tree participating in CES 2019with Kyungpook National University smart venture campus will plan to expandbusiness to USA.

On the other hand, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT, which isa global project zone which is formed as part of a project to help Korea'sstart-up into the global market, is attracting attention with variousactivities such as exhibition, pitching and party. Also, on the third eveningof the exhibition, MIK NIGHT party, a business networking party, will be held.In addition, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT will be jointly planned and operated byAVING NEWS and GMEG, a global MICE specialist company.CES 2019 is an innovative exhibition where technologycompanies that will lead the fourth industrial revolution will participate.
